Starry Addax has a special interest in Western Sahara
The malicious mobile application (APK), “FlexStarling,” analyzed by Talos recently masquerades as a variant of the Sahara Press Service (SPSRASD) App.
However, in actuality, FlexStarling is a highly versatile malware capable of deploying additional malware components and stealing information from the infected devices.
Depending on the requestor’s operating system, the website will either serve the FlexStarling APK for Android devices or redirect the victim to a social media login page to harvest their credentials.

The use of FlexStarling with a Firebase-based C2 instead of commodity malware or commercially available spyware indicates the threat actor is making a conscious effort to evade detections and operate without being detected.
